title: Decentralized golden-harness orchestrator for multi-arm rollouts and quarantine
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a decentralized orchestration layer (gatekeeper) that evaluates incoming canary/A-B/shadow traffic against customer-weighted golden prompt sets and scorecards. The gatekeeper will operate at two levels: local evaluators deployed with model variants (for low-latency per-request checks and prompt coverage stats) and a central coordinator that aggregates signals, applies quarantine rules, and triggers safe auto-rollbacks or traffic quarantines. This work focuses on policy encoding (thresholds, hysteresis, weighted prompts), integration points with the rollout engine, and a quarantine API used by routing/traffic managers.
acceptance_criteria: Local evaluator sidecar runs on dedicated pool nodes and emits per-prompt metrics (score, coverage, latency) to the coordinator
Coordinator computes rolling scorecards and applies quarantine rules within configured SLOs (windowed aggregates)
Automatic quarantine can reduce canary weight or divert traffic to fallback model without manual intervention
A/B experiments and shadowed traffic are supported: shadow results are evaluated without impacting live traffic but visible in dashboards
Integration tests covering staged rollout -> quarantine -> auto-rollback executed in CI with synthetic golden sets
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Chen: Filed initial RFC and spike notes. Motivation: recent false-negative rollouts where subtle semantic drift wasn't caught by single-metric monitors. Proposal for decentralized evaluators to reduce coordinator load and improve prompt coverage fidelity.

2025-02-20 Product review (Aisha Gomez): Agreed on gating by composite score (weighted by prompt criticality). Request: add per-customer threshold overrides and rollout metadata tagging for auditability.

notes: Trade-offs discussed: performing richer semantic evals (embedding distance) increases CPU cost and latency; we decided to use a hybrid approach - fast heuristics in hot path, async semantic re-eval for non-blocking score refinements. Need to capture anonymized prompt fingerprints for coverage without storing PII.
